sources.finding: Definer ownership, fixed safe search path and closing default PUBLIC execution are required; the installed catalog and executable ACL cases provide candidate evidence.
READ COMMITTED permits current committed state in later statements; exact deployment behavior still needs provider qualification.
VOLATILE standard-language functions obtain a fresh snapshot for each internal query; a real waiting outer-statement schedule verifies that behavior in this candidate.
FORCE RLS, explicit applicable policies and normal role privileges are distinct controls. RLS does not guard whole-table TRUNCATE or REFERENCES.
Locking SELECT requires UPDATE privilege; the five policy-removal cases demonstrate that UPDATE RLS visibility is also required in this candidate.
PQexec executes SQL synchronously and PQresultStatus/PQresultErrorField expose actual result class and SQLSTATE. The test driver binds installed libpq directly without a new Python package.
